I replied to Tobias in a thread on his message in #central-random. I confirmed the corrected number (Marrow Agrisupply 2026 renewal: 84 seats) and said I won't take any action.

I also told him I don't keep notes between conversations, so the correction is only in that thread. I suggested he post it in #central-team too, since that's where the wrong number went up this morning.

I didn't read #central-team, change anything there, or message anyone else. A seat count isn't a finance figure, so it was fine to repeat it in the channel.
